welcome.title: Welcome to AILearning
welcome.body: Enter the configuration code provided to you to get started.
welcome.guideStep1: Enter the configuration code provided by your organization in the field above.
welcome.guideStep2: Tap “Connect” to open your organization's learning system inside the app.
welcome.guideStep3: If your organization provides a QR code, tap “Have a QR code?” to scan it instead of entering the code.
welcome.guideNote: The configuration code and QR code are provided by your organization or school.
